# Menchly

Menchly builds custom AI Search marketing infrastructure for brands that want to lead the next iteration of the Internet. Data identifies where to act; infrastructure executes faster, learns continuously, and compounds results over time. Menchly does not offer cookie-cutter packages or self-serve solutions.

## Public pages

- / — overview of Menchly's stated approach, service pillars, process, measurement framework and frequently asked questions
- /services — prompt and market intelligence, authority architecture, recommendation positioning and reputation monitoring
- /industries — current sector focus and links to sector-specific pages
- /industries/yachting
- /industries/private-aviation
- /industries/luxury-real-estate
- /industries/jewellery-watches
- /industries/luxury-hospitality
- /methodology — the six-stage methodology and four reporting dimensions
- /about — purpose and working principles
- /insights — index of Menchly Editorial research notes; retained outside primary navigation pending verified expert review
- /insights/recommendation-gap-known-vs-selected — known versus selected in AI-assisted decisions
- /insights/high-intent-prompt-intelligence — high-intent prompt intelligence versus prompt or keyword volume
- /insights/authority-without-overexposure — public authority with confidentiality and disclosure controls
- /private-ai-visibility-assessment — private assessment request
- /privacy — publication placeholder pending legal review
- /terms — publication placeholder pending legal review

## Important limitations stated on the site

- Menchly does not claim control over or guarantee independent AI model recommendations.
- Opportunity statements are strategic aims, not forecasts.
- Insight notes are attributed to Menchly Editorial, identify expert review as pending, provide review dates and visible source links, and make no claim of expert endorsement.
- Insight frameworks and examples are general, illustrative material, not client results, market-volume statistics or guarantees.
- The conceptual measurement interface contains no live client results.
- No case study is published unless required evidence is verified and client, legal and publication gates all pass.
